Weekly Changelog

It's Friday and you know what that means!

Week of June 22–26, 2026

This week is all about control — two new ways to decide exactly when your agent
routes to a playbook or workflow. Here's everything new.

 

✨  New Features

Entry conditions

You can now gate any playbook or workflow behind entry conditions —
deterministic checks that have to be true before your agent can route there. If
the conditions aren't met, that path stays unavailable, giving you precise,
rule-based control over when each one becomes reachable.

single source of truth, so you can spend time actually getting things done.

Automation 



Get it done: 10 task automation ideas




Your to-do list lives in approximately seventeen places, and your brain is the 
least reliable one. Task automation fixes this without requiring you to 
overhaul how you work.



Zapier can automatically create tasks from emails, calendar events, voice 
memos, and anywhere else they come from. That means everything can be funneled 
into a single source of truth—and actually reflect some version of reality.

receivedReplies.bodyText:
Important GroqCloud notice. Switch your models now.

banner (https://email.groq.com/e3t/Ctc/2P+113/d5cCcQ04/VWF7tn3YY6PLW6M2L972R-w_-W1YzZHS5Q_YFkMGxfTK3prCCW6N1vHY6lZ3mcW4KSBvH6sqNBkW4R7nQj2FCqBvW6llfPl3mQxkCW3C07x47rc3kVVpGhCj4bRDPBW63Z9202zbnXLW397XLD6wsmHcW9jrrG78KcWxfW2mCB2s74DZMFW4Z87Lw7G1LV2Vy83-16WmtJZW5Lq1jB2XnWyVW2bHYND1z0pJ6W4-_yDr2h89LmVq1Qp11jlVzkW8r45c16b8f5-W22Gqkr44gLsrW4tjNC77vbnmhVc7X687tV68KW2Kzy4439tLMtW7y3G7v2JMB3QW1Tk-N53zBqkdf8ytDZY04 )

Hello Devs!

We want to inform you about the deprecation of the Llama 3.3 70B Versatile model.

We are deprecating Llama 3.3 70B Versatile today, and decommissioning it on August 16, 2026. After the decommission date, requests to the model will no longer be served.

We encourage you to transition your workloads to our recommended replacement model, GPT OSS 120B / Qwen3.6 27B, as soon as possible.

This deprecation applies to free and developer-tier usage. If you're an enterprise customer with a committed-spend contract, you are not affected — your access continues unchanged.

Additionally, you can view all models available on GroqCloud [here (https://email.groq.com/e3t/Ctc/2P+113/d5cCcQ04/VWF7tn3YY6PLW6M2L972R-w_-W1YzZHS5Q_YFkMGxfV03prCCW7lCdLW6lZ3kvW5bwMgc6Hj0-dW1jKKcT3chfy-VBmvk976BcxBW8lK5Jc784FnGW7ZYKyS8xmLFVN3Yf47PzSkWpW6GX_nm2KVwrfW3ZxY_75x7-j5VKqY2g1LrngzW353lG03SH5bbW2D4Bkp3hJhbBVr5QMz5xj5BWV4J1rT3XXkSHW20_9p0350DpsW8VcLPB20p9nNW9cc-Wq7CmsqlW2xV9Vn2zzXB2W5WM6X75xtGgVW1qLQGJ1HS8m0W7Y2d5l7YSyLRVst9cB2dytC2W3sZC8q9drt6MW1wG88b827xgvW2hJf-n1XpXFGf3CpZ4H04 ) ].

NEXT STEPS

Migration Support: Our team is ready to assist you with the transition process. Please reach out if you need guidance on how to migrate your workloads effectively.

Documentation: Detailed guides and resources are available in our developer portal.

We appreciate your understanding and support as we move forward with these enhancements. If you have any questions, feel free to reach out to us at support@groq.com (mailto:support@groq.com) or reply to this email.

Thanks for building with us,

The Groq Team

Weekly Changelog

New this week

Week of June 29–July 3, 2026

This week is all about memory — you can now decide exactly what your agent
remembers about returning users. Here's the details.

 

✨  New Features

Variable persistence control

You can now choose, per variable, whether its value carries across sessions for
the same user. Keep long-lived details like a name, preferences, or plan tier so
returning users pick up right where they left off — and reset session-only
values like verification codes every time. Just toggle Persist across sessions
on any variable.

receivedReplies.bodyText:
New this week · Week of July 6, 2026


WHAT WE SHIPPED

Two updates to help you evaluate smarter and merge with confidence.

Added


EVALUATIONS WITH LOG VISIBILITY

Evaluations just got a lot more observant. The new Log visibility setting lets
you control exactly what your evaluating model sees when it scores a transcript
— not just the conversation, but what your agent actually did behind the scenes.
Switch on playbook, workflow, and tool logs for richer context, or keep them off
to keep credit usage lean. Mix and match per evaluation.

receivedReplies.subject: The n8n MCP server just got better
receivedReplies.bodyText:
Custom and community nodes, workflow settings, live values, and version history and more additions to the MCP server  

 

n8n ( https://n8n.io/?utm_source=customerio&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=newsletter_product-update-mcp_202607&utm_content=logo )

 

Connect an AI tool to the n8n MCP server ( https://docs.n8n.io/changelog?utm_source=customerio&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=newsletter_product-update-mcp_202607&utm_content=mcp-release-notes-cta#n8n-2.29-mcp-server-updates )

Your AI tools can now do more in n8n
------------------------------------

You can build, edit, and run workflows in your n8n instance, using plain English when you connect Claude Code (or any other supported AI tool) to the n8n MCP server.

We're constantly improving performance behind the scenes, and shipping new features on top of it. Keep reading to learn what's new with our MCP server.

Or, just jump back into your instance, turn it on, and see what it can do.

 

MCP docs ( https://adurosakin.app.n8n.cloud/settings/mcp )

 

 

MCP server updates
------------------

 

 

Custom and community nodes icon

​

Custom and community nodes
--------------------------

Workflows built through MCP can now use the custom and community nodes installed on your instance, not just the built-in ones.

 

Workflow settings icon

​

Workflow settings
-----------------

Your AI tool can connect an error workflow, set the timezone, or adjust how executions run.

 

Live values icon

​

Live values for dynamic fields
------------------------------

Slack channels, Google Sheets tabs, and similar fields get filled with real values from your services, so workflows arrive ready to run.

 

Version history icon

​

Version history
---------------

Browse past versions of a workflow and restore one when you want to undo a change.

 

Read the release notes ( https://docs.n8n.io/changelog?utm_source=customerio&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=newsletter_product-update-mcp_202607&utm_content=mcp-release-notes-cta#n8n-2.29-mcp-server-updates )

 

2026 report on AI agent development tools ( https://n8n.io/reports/2026-ai-agent-development-tools/?utm_source=customerio&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=newsletter_product-update-mcp_202607&utm_content=report-card-image )

2026 report on AI agent development tools ( https://n8n.io/reports/2026-ai-agent-development-tools/?utm_source=customerio&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=newsletter_product-update-mcp_202607&utm_content=report-card-heading )
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

This report evaluates n8n against 15 platforms on real-world capabilities. The biggest finding: most tools are better at building agents than governing them.

Read the report ➔ ( https://n8n.io/reports/2026-ai-agent-development-tools/?utm_source=customerio&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=newsletter_product-update-mcp_202607&utm_content=report-card-cta )

​

2026 report on AI agent development tools ( https://n8n.io/reports/2026-ai-agent-development-tools/?utm_source=customerio&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=newsletter_product-update-mcp_202607&utm_content=report-card-image )

 

Blog posts & features
---------------------

Learn about our latest product features and featured blogs to help you get the most out of your n8n account.

 

Automatic updates for n8n Cloud ( https://docs.n8n.io/deploy/use-n8n-cloud/update-your-version?utm_source=customerio&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=newsletter_product-update-mcp_202607&utm_content=blog-card-autoupdates-image )

​

Automatic updates ( https://docs.n8n.io/deploy/use-n8n-cloud/update-your-version?utm_source=customerio&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=newsletter_product-update-mcp_202607&utm_content=blog-card-autoupdates-heading )
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Cloud instances can now update themselves, and you decide how. Choose security updates only, stick to stable releases, or opt into beta to get every release as it ships.

Read more ➔ ( https://docs.n8n.io/deploy/use-n8n-cloud/update-your-version?utm_source=customerio&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=newsletter_product-update-mcp_202607&utm_content=blog-card-autoupdates-cta )

 

Connect your AI agent to popular MCP servers ( https://docs.n8n.io/changelog?utm_source=customerio&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=newsletter_product-update-mcp_202607&utm_content=blog-card-mcpnodes-image#n8n-2.22-connect-to-mcp-servers-with-less-setup )

​

Your AI agent's toolset just got bigger ( https://docs.n8n.io/changelog?utm_source=customerio&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=newsletter_product-update-mcp_202607&utm_content=blog-card-mcpnodes-heading#n8n-2.22-connect-to-mcp-servers-with-less-setup )
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Connect your AI agent to popular MCP servers from the canvas with less setup. Connect to GitLab, Linear, Notion, and more. Just search for MCP in the Node panel when adding a tool to an agent.

Read more ➔ ( https://docs.n8n.io/changelog?utm_source=customerio&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=newsletter_product-update-mcp_202607&utm_content=blog-card-mcpnodes-cta#n8n-2.22-connect-to-mcp-servers-with-less-setup )

 

Build self-improving agent skills ( https://blog.n8n.io/skill-loop/?utm_source=customerio&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=newsletter_product-update-mcp_202607&utm_content=blog-card-skillloop-image )

​

Build self-improving agent skills ( https://blog.n8n.io/skill-loop/?utm_source=customerio&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=newsletter_product-update-mcp_202607&utm_content=blog-card-skillloop-heading )
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

A walkthrough on using cognee with n8n to build agent skills that improve every time they're used, so your agents keep getting sharper without you retraining anything.

Read more ➔ ( https://blog.n8n.io/skill-loop/?utm_source=customerio&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=newsletter_product-update-mcp_202607&utm_content=blog-card-skillloop-cta )

Improvements to tool call sounds

Tool call sounds got a tune-up. You now get manual volume control and more sound
options, the audio automatically drops in volume when your agent talks over it,
and it fades in and out for a more natural dialog — so the wait while your agent
works feels smoother and less jarring.

Today's Digest covers Claude Sonnet 5 in the Voice Agent API, Flux word-level timestamps, new agent interrupt controls, and Nova-3 language upgrades.

PRODUCT UPDATES

Flux STT Now Returns Word-Level Timestamps

Flux STT responses now include start and end times for every word, alongside the existing word and confidence values. That makes it easier to align transcripts to audio for captions, highlighting, and downstream timing logic. It's an additive change.

View Changelog
(https://e.deepgram.com/e3t/Ctc/5D+113/cQMRG04/VXhByp1Jxh57W42frm49jBvBbW2QY3Nh5RKfSbN3kz7Cl5m_5PW50kH_H6lZ3m9W6P39cm45cwClW6NJP9c3RD_9wW6NR-m-8KYyS7W5WVn181XBtH4N5b88KGqfkX4W5MvPm47Bq11tW1hdxPf3gQv8HW8dp1cr6ZMrT0W8gd9V11cgScXN8L_vXNZlTNMW5st-zt6WC7cGW8WDsxV2PP-B9W1LdX0476D7QQVf0Qt98hXxqHW9kXr_61GvnQGW8WmyQ-4QbmzdW88jFZ58tYPLzW8N9Sy56g82xBW7BGvp416nGyzW4zC4Zp3HqDNsW4fwvNr6fy7wtW42-p9b6q_MwBW1nGsDJ9cptQdW2dG91336zQJgW7JmnpF6l69RcW5RK3wk7DvtGxW19xCxt1hxdtJW4cL2-445hf1fW74_g-443y4_GW16FFJX1MMk0kW6g2s6w2x0KKLW2TvLJR69kgC4f4C9zrq04 )

PRODUCT UPDATES

Numerals Now Available in Flux STT

Flux STT now converts spoken numbers into numerals, so "nine hundred" becomes 900. It works on Flux English and Flux Multilingual (English, Spanish, French, German, Russian, Portuguese, Italian, Dutch). Set numerals=true when you open the WebSocket.

View Docs
(https://e.deepgram.com/e3t/Ctc/5D+113/cQMRG04/VXhByp1Jxh57W42frm49jBvBbW2QY3Nh5RKfSbN3kz7DR3prCCW7Y8-PT6lZ3mRW1YzTrj2CMscsW59b2d24W8W0nW6yRgCs5cVFcbN8_WZKL8ZjmcW75jQ8y3sLLW8W8Sd5ch8y886kW6Pr2xB7h1fMcW2GGmkd7Pw148VvvTHG3yLyQJW5BmD-g841qh-N2rxKypBdpj3W4pD76W2xjnKCW7gybsF5y5m1fW8hgHHR2N9r6LW8mRQZZ2pcx43W1YCmjD2_F0ffW76cDV35s7k0lW4Pt2hQ5kkf0nW7wwxZn3ZSX2_W3x55LY3Qc8R8W1Dd2Wt3qFZcyW5G3xJW7KpXk5W8jJRVm6wGXxlW5Bh-xF8CYYbLN5Gw-CzXJrgkN8stF2Vjjg4xf7pSGF004 )

Improved Nova-3 Models for 10+ Languages

We've released improved Nova-3 monolingual models for languages including German, French, Turkish, Dutch, Greek, and Ukrainian, across batch and streaming. Accuracy is better for both workloads, and you don't need to change any API requests to get them.

Welcome, friends!
-----------------

I'll keep this intro short, since I'm still recovering from n8n Fest.

I had a great time meeting and speaking to so many of you! We don't take it for granted that hundreds of you came to party with us in Berlin. 

Our first n8n Conference this October will be another chance to gather with the rest of the community and the n8n Team. We have big plans for it: sign up below to be the first to hear the details.

Read on for more exciting stories, from a webinar with the n8n docs team, to a workflow that automates your job search, and a podcast episode with the creator of our MCP server.

Enjoy!

Bart
Community Lead

 

 

 

( https://n8n.io/intheloop/?utm_source=customerio&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2026_q3_june_community_newsletter&utm_content=conference-banner-image )

In The Loop 2026

We’re hosting n8n’s first official conference in Berlin this October.

In The Loop 2026 will bring together builders, customers, and the leaders shaping the future of automation. Hear real production stories, learn how top teams build reliable workflows, celebrate the n8n community, and discover where automation is headed next.

Be among the first to access early-bird tickets.

Sign up now ( https://n8n.io/intheloop/?utm_source=customerio&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2026_q3_june_community_newsletter&utm_content=conference-cta )

At Mercari, CX Systems Manager Eric McNulty built a Zapier-powered system that 
resolves 47K+ tickets a month. At ZapConnect, he'll demonstrate that the most 
powerful AI agents aren't the most complex; they're the ones anyone can 
maintain.

Blair Mishleau, Senior Community Education Manager at Patreon, built 'Treon, a 
Slack assistant that has answered 1300+ employee questions with information 
from 600+ real sources. He'll teach you how to build a personal context layer 
so your AI tools stop guessing and start working with you. 



3. Create governance that lets you say "yes" 
When Jeff Hirsch joined Redis as a System Architect, the company was ramping 
up their org-wide use of Zapier. So Jeff built the foundation first: secure 
sign-on, limits for the most sensitive apps, and one clear path for teams to 
request what they wanted built. He'll share what he learned along the way and 
why good governance doesn't slow AI down.

Environment Protection

You can now lock an environment so only admins and owners can publish or merge
into it. Everyone else keeps building and testing exactly as before — they just
can't push changes into production by accident. Switch on Environment protection
from the environment's ••• menu in Settings → Environments.

Cost limit

Set a maximum spend per conversation and Voiceflow ends the session once it's
crossed. It's a hard ceiling on any single conversation, however long it runs or
however many tools it calls. Add an optional End message to close things out
gracefully. Off by default, under Settings → Behaviour.

Max conversation duration for phone calls

Cap how long a single call can run. Set a limit in seconds and Voiceflow ends
the conversation when it's reached, so a caller who stays on the line
indefinitely — or an agent stuck in a loop — can't quietly burn through credits.
An optional End message plays first, so the call gets a proper sign-off instead
of a dropped line.
